description:
Lauf Cycling and Pirate Cycling League are pleased to introduce the Limited Edition Pirate Cycling League Lauf Seigla!

Pirate Cycling League is a group of gravel-loving individuals who host the Gravel Worlds® in Lincoln, Nebraska. The Pirate Cycling League (PCL) was created to be an inclusive club for everyone. A team for the team-less that breaks down barriers to participation. So we encourage you all to get on your Lauf Seigla and go sail the gravel seas however that looks for you. Whether you prefer a 300+ mile adventure on the most difficult roads you can find, or a 10-mile journey down a flat road you will find the Lauf Seigla Pirate Cycling League edition will get you where your body wants to take you.

You don’t need to be a “member” of the Pirate Cycling League to purchase this bike. The PCL is simply a group of riders who welcome everyone in. Our only rule? Rule #1: BE COOL! Treat other people with respect and you’re welcome to be a pirate! We do sell team kit a few times a year, but you are more than welcome to simply call yourself a pirate and you’re cool in our book!
